defects: Darkening improved the oak/walnut contrast, but the oak figure is now several high-contrast periodic waves across each large panel.
The strong wave pattern is visible at gameplay distance and distracts from the case construction.
Shelf-pin and joinery details remain difficult to read and were not addressed by this material-only iteration.
hard_fail_reasons: The surface-variation gate fails: large repeated waves dominate both side panels and are explicitly prohibited by the approved brief.
The close-inspection gate fails: the wood pattern is too broad and regular to read as the target's fine board-aligned grain.
incumbent_comparison: Compared with v001, v002 improves the dark stained color balance but the exaggerated wave pattern is more distracting and less faithful to the target; retain v001 as the best overall 3D review candidate until the final alternate is assessed.
likely_causes: The targeted French-oak procedural profile uses too few broad cycles and too much amplitude for a 63-inch bookcase face.
Per-face normalized UVs repeat the same broad pattern across separate boards and panels.
next_action_hypothesis: Use the third and final alternate material strategy with the same darker palette but a dedicated fine-grain profile: many low-amplitude longitudinal fibers, subtle irregular rays, and no broad periodic waves. Preserve the current geometry and inspect the same production views.

observations.art_direction_fit: Color balance improved, but the broad repeating wood pattern moves farther from the target's fine natural grain.
observations.close_up_quality: The close detail makes the repeated wave pattern dominant; the grain scale looks synthetic and overwhelms the joinery.
observations.gameplay_readability: The bookcase remains distinct at 73 inches and the shelf bays and books remain legible.
observations.geometric_detail: The same solid shelf boards, nosings, side panels, crown, plinth, and individual book groups are visible.
observations.material_realism: The darker oak and deeper walnut move closer to the approved target, but the side panels now show conspicuous periodic waves rather than believable fine grain.
observations.proportion: The v002 dimensions and shelf layout are unchanged and remain within the authoritative envelope.
observations.scale_fidelity: Godot 4.7.2 reports 32 x 63 x 17.06 inches against the 32 x 63 x 17 inch RoomDefinition envelope.
observations.semantic_recognizability: The gameplay and close captures remain clearly identifiable as the same five-bay Room A household bookcase.
observations.silhouette_quality: The full-height case, crown, plinth, feet, and inset side panels are retained from v001.
observations.surface_variation: Variation is stronger than v001 but occurs as a few large repeated bands across each panel, which conflicts with the required restrained board-aligned finish.
observations.technical_integration: Godot imported the GLB without issues and rendered it through the review-only registry in Room A with 50 citizens.

close_inspection.evidence: The detail capture shows a few conspicuous repeated waves across the side panels instead of the target's fine wood figure.

edge_treatment.evidence: The crown cap, shelf nosings, plinth, and feet retain softened edges in the close production capture.

hardware.evidence: The production capture does not make the fitted shelf pins clearly readable at the scale shown.

joins.evidence: The face stiles and side-panel rails remain visible, but their joins do not read convincingly beneath the dominating wave pattern.

manufacturing_detail.evidence: The case structure is present, but the wave pattern obscures board-level finish and the fitted pins remain difficult to see.

material_response.evidence: The darker brown color is closer to the target, but the high-contrast broad waves are not a plausible stained-oak response.

surface_variation.evidence: Surface variation is present but too broad, repeated, and high contrast to match the fine board-aligned target grain.

thickness.evidence: The detail capture shows solid shelf thickness, nosings, side panels, and layered top and base construction.

neutral_viewer_realism.evidence: The candidate still reads as a household bookcase with believable cabinet proportions, although the large-panel material treatment needs correction.

photo_character.evidence: This ArtBrief has no source photograph; the approved Visual Director target supplies the appearance reference.

visual_transfer_diagnosis.corrective_action: Replace the broad French-oak profile with a separate bookcase fine-grain profile using higher longitudinal frequency, low contrast, subtle irregularity, and the current darker palette; keep geometry unchanged and compare the same Room A views.
lost_visual_information: The target's fine, low-contrast longitudinal grain has become a few broad, repeating waves across each side panel.
The approved target's dark stained wood remains closer in color than v001, but the wood figure is too regular and visually dominant.
preserved_components: The same five-bay household bookcase geometry, side-panel frames, shelf nosings, crown, plinth, feet, and muted books.
The 32 x 63 x 17 inch authoritative Room A envelope and the review-only production integration.
